chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns his poisoned enemy didn't die—he 'became a Buddha.' In a world where belief shapes reality, Xin Hui's temple hides a monstrous secret under its holy mask.
og_title: What Happens When You Lie a Buddha Into Existence? | Chapter 43
og_description: Xin Hui drops a reality-shattering truth: Danyangzi is now a formless monster shaped by Li Huowang's own terrified belief. The temple's piety hides a watching eye.

twitter_description: Danyangzi didn't die. He became a Buddha. In a world of blood and lies, belief is the deadliest poison of all.
